title: malisper/pgrust
claim: malisper/pgrust — Postgres rewritten in Rust, already passing 100% of the Postgres regression tests.
hook: Postgres, rewritten in Rust — and it already passes 100% of Postgres's own regression tests.
why_good: A ground-up rewrite of Postgres in Rust that already matches Postgres 18.3 output across 46,000+ regression queries and is disk-compatible — it can boot straight from an existing Postgres data directory.
value: The engine isn't the business; a managed/embedded offering or enterprise support on a safer, faster Postgres (the Cockroach/ClickHouse path) is — once it's production-ready.
risk: It says plainly it's not production-ready or perf-optimized yet, and extensions like PL/Python aren't compatible. Getting a Postgres reimplementation to 'run your bank on it' is a multi-year slog against a free, battle-tested incumbent. Watch the published benchmarks and first production users.

zh.claim: malisper/pgrust —— 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres,已经 100% 通过 Postgres 官方回归测试。
zh.hook: 用 Rust 重写的 Postgres——而且已经 100% 通过了 Postgres 自己的回归测试。
zh.why_good: 用 Rust 从零重写的 Postgres,已在 46,000+ 条回归查询上匹配 Postgres 18.3 的输出,而且磁盘兼容——能直接从现有的 Postgres 数据目录启动。
zh.value: 引擎本身不是生意;在更安全、更快的 Postgres 之上做托管/嵌入式产品或企业支持(Cockroach/ClickHouse 的路子)才是——前提是达到生产可用。
zh.risk: 它明说还没到生产可用、也没做性能优化,PL/Python 等扩展也还不兼容。把一个 Postgres 重写版做到『敢让银行用』是多年苦役,对手还是免费、久经沙场的原版。看它公开的基准和第一批生产用户。
zh.does: 用 Rust 从零重写的 Postgres,已在 46,000+ 条回归查询上匹配 Postgres 18.3 的输出,而且磁盘兼容——能直接从现有的 Postgres 数据目录启动。
zh.edge: 作者称尚未发布的新版本已 100% 通过 Postgres 回归套件、事务负载快约 50%、分析负载快约 300 倍(逼近 ClickHouse)——一个『Postgres 兼容』又有 HTAP 级分析性能的引擎,若成立就很重磅。
zh.why_use: 卖点:保留 Postgres 兼容和你的数据文件,却拿到内存安全和快得多的分析性能——是『原地替换』,而不是迁到另一套分析数据库。

does: A ground-up rewrite of Postgres in Rust that already matches Postgres 18.3 output across 46,000+ regression queries and is disk-compatible — it can boot straight from an existing Postgres data directory.
edge: A newer unpublished build reportedly passes 100% of the Postgres regression suite, is ~50% faster on transactional workloads and ~300x faster on analytical ones (approaching ClickHouse) — a Postgres-compatible engine with HTAP-class analytics is a big deal if it holds up.
why_use: The pitch: keep Postgres compatibility and your data files, but gain memory-safety and far faster analytics — a drop-in path instead of migrating to a separate analytics database.
